headline_stat.name: median mean-resultant-length R (HD cells) / decoding median abs error
headline_stat.value: R=0.74 (HD) vs 0.13 (non-HD); decode 11 deg, circ r=0.91

justification.dataset: Dandiset 000939 (mouse postsubiculum, Peyrache/Ajabi lab) is a canonical, expert-standard choice for head direction cells.
justification.handling: Real ~30 GB NWB streamed by byte-range with remfile, 100 Hz HD angle wrapped in Tsd with NaN samples dropped, correct epoch/spike alignment and explicit author HD labels.
justification.analysis: Standard and correct: mean-resultant-vector circular statistics, cross-arena coherent-rotation analysis, and held-out Bayesian decoding, all appropriate for circular data.
justification.correctness: Reported numbers (R=0.74 vs 0.13, 37 deg coherent rotation R=0.96, corr 0.23->0.94, decode 11 deg / r=0.91) trace to the committed code, are internally consistent, and match the figures.
justification.figures: Figures are clearly labeled with units and sample sizes and show the effect unambiguously; example units are ranked by tuning strength R, which is the effect being demonstrated.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to visibly strong, clean evidence and nothing is contradicted by the figures, but no explicit limitations are stated (single session, reliance on author labels, ring-attractor framing), a minor fault on a clean result.
